wineNotes.note: The Navigator, our flagship red, pays homage to Prince Henry, the patron of early Portuguese exploration who instigated the first voyages in the discovery of new trade routes.
Adamastor, our flagship white, is named after the mythical sea god of wind and storms in tribute to the tempestuous conditions which our vines have had to constantly endure.
The great vision and sense of adventure of these early explorers in discovering a sea route to the strange and spice-rich East is celebrated by the First Sighting Range.
our Pofadderbos Sauvignon Blanc gets its name from the many encounters with the local Puff Adder snake residents in the vineyards of Strandveld.
The wine is named after the very rare Protea pudens, affectionately known as the “Skaamgesiggie” or Bashful Sugarbush because of its unique downward hanging flowers.
